compactAtContextTokens 150k matches pi context window.

pi settings (~/.pi/agent/settings.json): defaultProvider cli-openai, defaultModel zaicp/glm-5.3-flash, defaultThinkingLevel high, thinkingBudgets {minimal 512, low 2048, medium 8192, high 16384}, enabledModels 5 with :high suffix.

models.json defines per-model contextWindow, maxTokens, cost, reasoning, thinkingFormat compat, input types, tags [T][V][XL][L]; e.g. MiniMax 1048576 ctx/65536 max/0.3-1.2.

web-fetch code constants: DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS 30s, MAX_RESPONSE_SIZE 5MB, MAX_PDF_SIZE 20MB, MIN_USEFUL_CONTENT 500, JINA fallback r.jina.ai.
No-config extensions: quiz, ask-user-question, visual-tools, md-log, snip all use per-call params only.

Infrastructure locked today: yt-dlp config --js-runtimes node, ffmpeg BtbN build in ~/.local/bin, CLIProxyAPI payload default reasoning_split wildcard, Paseo daemon 0.6.1.

subagent-types: 5 role .md files pin model+thinking+tools; ask_question default wait 90s/max 300s in code; channel queue dir ~/.pi/agent/subagent-channel; interrupt opt-in per call.

5 real role pins: scout=cli-openai/mmcp/MiniMax-M3 high, researcher=cli-openai/zaicp/glm-5.3-flash high, worker=cli-openai/zaicp/glm-5.3 high, mermaid-maker=cli-openai/zaicp/glm-5.3-flash max, svg-maker=cli-openai/zaicp/glm-5.3-flash max.

Only delta between user's desired role table and reality is mermaid/svg-makers are currently thinking max (higher than user's requested high); assistant decided to keep max for image quality and inform user it is one word to change if preferred.
ask_question default found in subagent-types/index.ts:690 description 'Default 90, max 300' and line 706 clamps wait_seconds ?? 90 between 1 and 300.

Observer failure semantics from observer-trigger.ts: on non-zero exit or missing result, catch records lastWorkerError, status.workerError(runId), notifies 'om: observer failed'; observations not written, chunk entries remain uncovered, next trigger re-slices from last covered point so the observation auto-regenerates; cost of failed run still recorded.

Consolidator failure semantics from consolidator-trigger.ts: on clean exit it trusts and re-folds against current branch so it never tombstones observations committed during the run; on non-zero exit throws error and cost still recorded.

Z.ai/GLM Chat Completion API supports built-in web_search tool via tools array with params enable, search_engine (default search_pro_jina), search_query, count (1-50 default 10), search_domain_filter, search_recency_filter, content_size, search_result, search_prompt; model itself executes server-side.

MiniMax provides server-side web_search server tool (beta), accessible only through Anthropic Messages API at https://api.minimax.io/anthropic/v1/messages, declared as versioned type web_search_20250305 in tools array.
MiniMax M3 has an open GitHub issue that the Anthropic-compatible endpoint does not support the web_search tool.
